turns.prompt:
You are given one attached CSV file:
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

No property values are provided. Using your knowledge of crystal optics,
crystal symmetry and structure-property relationships, predict which
candidates have the LARGEST SHG tensor component |d_ij| (pm/V), then select
the 5 best candidates from the pool.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The SHG tensor vanishes by symmetry in any centrosymmetric crystal, so only non-centrosymmetric candidates can have nonzero \(d_{ij}\). Among the latter, the magnitude of the largest component is governed by well-established structure–property relations: (i) small electronic band gap (Miller’s rule), (ii) high density of polarizable covalent bonds (Te, As, Se \(\gg\) S, O, halogen), and (iii) constructive geometric alignment of the NLO-active units (tetrahedra or lone-pair pyramids).

Application of these criteria immediately isolates a handful of stand-outs:

- c055 (hexagonal AlGaAs polytype) inherits the exceptionally large bond hyperpolarizability of GaAs (\(d_{14}\approx90{-}170\) pm V\(^{-1}\)) together with the polar \(P6_3mc\) alignment of a 6H stacking sequence.
- c073 (CdIn\(_3\)AsTe\(_4\)) combines the heaviest, most polarizable anions (Te+As) in a low-symmetry cell that permits all tensor elements; the expected gap is well below 1.5 eV.
- c030 (chalcopyrite CdSiP\(_2\)) is a known IR NLO crystal with measured \(d_{36}=84.5\) pm V\(^{-1}\).
- c070 (sulvanite-type Cu\(_3\)TaTe\(_4\)) is tetrahedral, non-centrosymmetric (\(P\overline{4}3m\)) and built entirely from highly polarizable Cu–Te and Ta–Te bonds.
- c083 (LiAsS\(_2\)) contains aligned AsS\(_3\) pyramids; analogous alkali pnictogen chalcogenides exhibit SHG responses an order of magnitude larger than AgGaS\(_2\).

All other candidates are either centrosymmetric, possess substantially larger gaps (oxides, chlorides, SiC polytypes, BeSe, \ldots), or display poorer alignment of their NLO-active fragments, and therefore have smaller \(|d_{ij}|\).

Final: c055, c073, c030, c070, c083
